body.query: let N = toint('@{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['incidentNumber']}'); SecurityIncident | where IncidentNumber == N | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber | project IncidentName, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Description, Owner=tostring(Owner), AlertIds=tostring(AlertIds), CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime, LastActivityTime

let N = toint('@{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['incidentNumber']}'); let inc = SecurityIncident | where IncidentNumber == N | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber; SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) | join kind=inner (inc | mv-expand aid=todynamic(AlertIds) | project SystemAlertId=tostring(aid)) on SystemAlertId | project AlertName, AlertSeverity, TimeGenerated, Tactics, Description=substring(Description,0,500), Entities=tostring(Entities) | take 30

runError.message: Security Copilot returned a capacity/usage error instead of a report (e.g. 'Try rewording your prompt' / 'Copilot can't respond'). No comment was posted. Increase provisioned SCUs or enable overage units on the Security Copilot capacity, then re-run.
